newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal public works to rise in 1997 - study.
newsitem.headline: Portugal public works to rise in 1997 - study.

text.p: The volume of public works in Portugal will increase by 5.3 percent this year as work intensifies on big infrastructure projects around Lisbon and local authorities prepare for elections, according to the National Association of Public Works Contractors (ANEOP).

An ANEOP study, published in the weekly Expresso newspaper, said the investment value of public works which were begun or were under way in January had risen 53 percent compared with the same period last year.

ANEOP said that work on Lisbon's Expo '98 world exhibition site, the building of a new Tagus road bridge and the extension of the Lisbon underground rail system would contribute to a buoyant construction industry.
It said local elections due in December would help to boost public works too as local authorities tried to impress voters.
